responses.message: does grok have an export for my conversations? like json. building an importer for a research notebook (engelbart) and a pilot user asked for grok support

Yes — you can request a data export from your account settings; it arrives as a downloadable archive that includes your conversation history in JSON. Each conversation carries its id, title, timestamps and the list of messages with sender (human/assistant), message text, and timestamps; responses can also include web search results and referenced X posts.

For an importer, practical notes:
- Treat the export as the source of truth; there isn't a stable public endpoint for reading a user's personal chat history.
- Key on conversation id for dedupe across repeated exports — users will export more than once.
- Keep the referenced-sources fields; they're useful provenance ("this answer cited these pages").
